description: Generate TODO.md from ADRs with comprehensive task breakdown. Decomposes each ADR into paired test+production tasks (TDD), links tasks to release milestones, and preserves manual edits via a bounded HTML-comment section. Re-runs are idempotent; tasks for deleted/superseded ADRs move to a Stale Tasks section.

adrDirectory.description: Directory containing ADR files (relative to projectPath)

dryRun.description: Compute changes but do not write TODO.md (preview only)

linkToMilestones.description: Link generated tasks to release milestones (local + GitHub merged)

phase.description: TDD pairing — "both" emits paired test+production tasks (default), "production" or "test" narrows output

projectPath.description: Project root path (defaults to current working directory)

scope.description: Which ADRs to decompose: all, pending (proposed/draft), or accepted only

name: generate_adr_todo
